operators.name: custom_mean
semantics: Computes the mean of input tensor x along dimension dim=0.
Equivalent to torch.mean(x, dim=0) for float32 CUDA tensor.
Output has the same shape as x except the reduced dimension is removed (size 1).
The reduction is performed over the first dimension (batch size 16).
No keepdim, so output shape is [3, 4096, 4096].
Return a new tensor with same dtype and device as input.

operators.name: custom_hardswish
semantics: Applies Hardswish activation function elementwise: x * relu6(x + 3) / 6.
Equivalent to nn.Hardswish()(x) for float32 CUDA tensor.
Input and output have the same shape [3, 4096, 4096].
Return a new tensor with same dtype and device as input.
Mean over batch dimension (dim=0) of input tensor [16,3,4096,4096].
Result is a tensor [3,4096,4096] with float32 dtype on CUDA.
Hardswish activation applied elementwise to mean output.
Result is a tensor [3,4096,4096] with float32 dtype on CUDA.
Return the final tensor after Hardswish.
